verdict.rationale: Drata's open-source agent reads system preferences to check screensaver locking, password manager, antivirus and automatic updates. A community report confirms that employees without the agent show as noncompliant per person in the Drata dashboard. The Devices API also allows pushing device data via custom connections. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of disk-encryption checks, documented MDM integrations (e.g., Jamf/Intune/Kandji), and in-depth first-party docs on the per-employee device compliance view (the device custom-connection endpoint is marked experimental).
